title: The Quiet Summer
author: J. M. Brightwater
blurb: Freya Sandoval, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
